articlePageHeader.summary: A look back at the quarter: what shipped, what broke, and what comes next.

page.summary: A look back at the quarter: what shipped, what broke, and what comes next.

content.text: The headline win: previews now render in under a second.

Under the hood, the gains came from four areas — a leaner block registry, streamed exports, smarter caching, and a renewed focus on editor latency. Each is small on its own; together they remake how the product feels day to day.
Read the full retrospective on the team blog.
